dedupe_keys.name: evaluating highlighting and promoting concrete masonry construction for storm surge resilience in contemporary low rise buildings

description: Evaluating, highlighting, and promoting concrete masonry construction for storm-surge resilience in contemporary low-rise buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). The system under investigation is masonry construction exposed to flood and storm-surge hazards in coastal and flood-prone communities. This dataset was created through a research program combining state-of-knowledge reviews, expert surveys, laboratory experiments, numerical modeling, and market studies to improve understanding of masonry structural systems under flood loading. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: storm surge, concrete masonry, state-of-knowledge reviews, expert survey. Published 2026-07-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
